title: Surreal Cosmic Sorceress
description: A green-skinned sorceress in a flowing purple robe and ornate headdress stands on a broken stone bridge, holding a small red mouse in her hand. Above her, a giant stylized eye with a pink iris and mechanical segments floats in a swirling purple and orange cosmic sky filled with clouds, floating temples, cherry blossoms, and glowing orbs.
